translations.zh_cn: 黄铜漏斗可以一次提取一组物品

translations.en_us: The value panel allows for precise control over the extracted stack size.
translations.zh_cn: 使用面板可以精确调节黄铜漏斗的提取数量。

translations.en_us: Using items on the filter slot will restrict the funnel to only transfer matching stacks.
translations.zh_cn: 对过滤槽使用某个物品，可以限制漏斗的行为，使其只传输匹配的物品。

translations.en_us: Brass Tunnels can be used to cover up your belts
translations.zh_cn: 黄铜隧道可以遮掩住你的传送带

translations.en_us: Brass Tunnels have filter slots on each open side
translations.zh_cn: 隧道的每一个开口面都有过滤槽

translations.en_us: Filters on inbound connections simply block non-matching items
translations.zh_cn: 在输入处的过滤槽仅会阻挡住不匹配的物品

translations.en_us: Filters on outbound connections can be used to sort items by type
translations.zh_cn: 输出处的过滤槽可用于以种类为依据的物品整理

translations.en_us: Whenever a passing item has multiple valid exits, the distribution mode will decide how to handle it
translations.zh_cn: 当通过的物品有多个有效输出端时，那么隧道的分配模式将会决定如何调度这些物品

translations.en_us: Brass Tunnels on parallel belts will form a group
translations.zh_cn: 连接了平行传送带的黄铜隧道，会将隧道、传送带组成一个组

translations.en_us: Incoming Items will now be distributed across all connected exits
translations.zh_cn: 输入的物品现在会分配到所有连接的输出端

translations.en_us: For this, items can also be inserted into the Tunnel block directly
translations.zh_cn: 在这一情况下，你也可以将物品直接输入到隧道方块中

translations.en_us: Distribution Modes of the Brass Tunnel
The distribution behaviour of Brass Tunnels can be configured
translations.zh_cn: 黄铜隧道的分配模式可以调节

translations.en_us: 'Synchronize Inputs' is a unique setting for Brass Tunnels
translations.zh_cn: “同步输入”是黄铜隧道的一种特殊设定

translations.en_us: Items are only allowed past if every tunnel in the group has one waiting
translations.zh_cn: 只有在组内全部的隧道都有一个等待通过的物品时，物品才能通过此隧道

translations.en_us: This ensures that all affected belts supply items at the same rate
translations.zh_cn: 这确保了所有受影响的传送带能够以相同的速率进行物品补给

translations.en_us: 'Split' will attempt to distribute the stack evenly between available outputs
translations.zh_cn: “分流”会尝试在可用输出端之间均匀分配物品堆

translations.en_us: If an output is unable to take more items, it will be skipped
translations.zh_cn: 如果某个输出端无法容纳更多的物品，那它会被跳过，不参与计算

translations.en_us: 'Forced Split' will never skip outputs, and instead wait until they are free
translations.zh_cn: “强制分流”不会跳过某个输出端，而是一直等待此输出端能够容纳更多物品，才会继续物品传输

translations.en_us: 'Round Robin' keeps stacks whole, and cycles through outputs iteratively
translations.zh_cn: “轮询调度”会保持物品堆完整，循环检索各个输出端，满足条件后分配整堆物品

translations.en_us: Once Again, if an output is unable to take more items, it will be skipped
translations.zh_cn: 与分流类似，如果某个输出端无法容纳更多物品，那它会被跳过
“强制轮询调度”不会跳过某个输出端

translations.en_us: 'Prefer Nearest' prioritizes the outputs closest to the items' input location
translations.zh_cn: “最近优先”会将物品优先分配到距离输入端更近的输出端

translations.en_us: 'Randomize' will distribute whole stacks to randomly picked outputs
translations.zh_cn: “随机”会随机选择一个输出端，一次性分配整堆物品
使用矿车装配站移动结构

translations.en_us: Powered Cart Assemblers mount attached structures to passing Minecarts
translations.zh_cn: 矿车装配站会将它所连接的结构安装到矿车上

translations.en_us: Without a redstone signal, it disassembles passing cart contraptions back into blocks
translations.zh_cn: 若没有通入红石信号，它会将矿车结构拆解为方块的形式

translations.en_us: Using a Wrench on the Minecart will let you carry the Contraption elsewhere
translations.zh_cn: 对着结构化的矿车使用你的扳手，就可以将其变为物品形式

translations.en_us: Whenever two Cart Assemblers share an attached structure...
translations.zh_cn: 若两个矿车装配站连接在同一结构下……

translations.en_us: Powering either of them will create a Carriage Contraption
translations.zh_cn: 给其中的任意一方的矿车装配站通入红石信号，都会组装矿车结构

translations.en_us: The carts will behave like those connected via Minecart Coupling
translations.zh_cn: 两辆矿车此时的行为与用矿车连轴器连接在一起时十分相似

translations.en_us: Cart Contraptions will rotate to face towards their carts' motion
translations.zh_cn: 矿车结构会随着矿车的运动而发生转向

translations.en_us: This Arrow indicates which side of the Structure will be considered the front
translations.zh_cn: 该箭头将指定结构的哪一侧会被视为“正面”

translations.en_us: If the Assembler is set to Lock Rotation, the contraptions' orientation will never change
translations.zh_cn: 如果装配站的配置为“旋转锁定”，那么结构的方向将不会改变

translations.en_us: Other types of Minecarts and Rails
translations.zh_cn: 另外几种矿车以及铁轨

translations.en_us: Cart Assemblers on Regular Tracks will not affect the passing carts' motion
translations.zh_cn: 放置在普通轨道上的矿车装配站并不会影响路过的矿车结构

translations.en_us: When on Powered or Controller Rail, the carts will be held in place until it's Powered
translations.zh_cn: 如果放置在动力铁轨或控制铁轨上且没有通入红石信号，矿车结构将停在此处，直到再次充能

translations.en_us: Other types of Minecarts can be used as the anchor
translations.zh_cn: 另外的几种矿车可以当作锚点来使用

translations.en_us: Furnace Carts will keep themselves powered, pulling fuel from any attached inventories
translations.zh_cn: 动力矿车会试图始终保持燃烧状态，并从任何连接的容器内提取燃料

translations.en_us: Relaying rotational force using Chain Conveyors
translations.zh_cn: 使用锁链传动轮传递旋转力

translations.en_us: Right-click two conveyors with chains to connect them
translations.zh_cn: 用锁链右击两个锁链传动轮以连接它们

translations.en_us: Chain conveyors relay rotational power between each other..
translations.zh_cn: 锁链传动轮之间可以互相传递旋转力……

translations.en_us: ..and connect to shafts above or below them
translations.zh_cn: ……并连接到它们上方或下方的传动杆

translations.en_us: Right-click holding a wrench to start travelling on the chain
translations.zh_cn: 手持扳手时右击可以跟随锁链移动

translations.en_us: At a junction, face towards a chain to follow it
translations.zh_cn: 在交汇处，面向某条锁链的方向即可跟随它运动

translations.en_us: Relaying rotational force with Chain Drives
translations.zh_cn: 使用链式传动箱传递旋转力

translations.en_us: Chain Drives relay rotation to each other in a row
translations.zh_cn: 同一排的链式传动箱会相互传递旋转力

translations.en_us: All shafts connected like this will rotate in the same direction
translations.zh_cn: 所有以此种方式连接的传动杆都会以相同的方向进行旋转

translations.en_us: Any part of the row can be rotated by 90 degrees
translations.zh_cn: 同一排的任意一个传动箱，旋转 90 度之后仍可以正常工作

translations.en_us: Controlling rotational speed with Chain Gearshifts
translations.zh_cn: 利用可调节链式传动箱进行转速调节

translations.en_us: Unpowered Chain Gearshifts behave exactly like Chain Drives
translations.zh_cn: 未充能的可调节链式传动箱与普通链式传动箱无异

translations.en_us: When Powered, the speed transmitted to other Chain Drives in the row is doubled
translations.zh_cn: 当被充能时，它会将转速加倍并传递至其他链式传动箱

translations.en_us: Whenever the Powered Gearshift is not at the source, its speed will be halved instead
translations.zh_cn: 若被充能的可调节传动箱并不是动力输入端，则会将转速减半

translations.en_us: In both cases, Chain Drives in the row always run at 2x the speed of the Powered Gearshift
translations.zh_cn: 在这两种情况下，同排链式传动箱的转速始终是充能的可调节链式传动箱的两倍

translations.en_us: Using analog signals, the ratio can be adjusted more precisely between 1 and 2
translations.zh_cn: 转速的倍率可在 ×1 和 ×2 间根据红石信号的强弱来精确调整
使用溜槽向下运输物品

translations.en_us: Chutes can transport items vertically from and to inventories
translations.zh_cn: 溜槽可在两个容器之间垂直传输物品

translations.en_us: Using the Wrench, a window can be created
translations.zh_cn: 使用扳手右击可以在溜槽上设置观察窗

translations.en_us: Using Industrial Iron Blocks, chutes can be encased
translations.zh_cn: 工业铁块可用于装饰溜槽

translations.en_us: Placing chutes targeting the side faces of another will make it diagonal
translations.zh_cn: 对着另一个溜槽的侧面放置溜槽，将会放置下一个斜向的溜槽
使用溜槽向上运输物品

translations.en_us: Using Encased Fans at the top or bottom, a Chute can move items upward
translations.zh_cn: 在溜槽上或下方使用鼓风机时，物品会根据风的方向向上或下移动

translations.en_us: Inspecting chutes with Engineers' Goggles reveals information about the movement direction
translations.zh_cn: 佩戴工程师护目镜时，你可以看见物品的移动方向

translations.en_us: On the 'blocked' end, items will have to be inserted/taken from the sides
translations.zh_cn: 若溜槽的末端被挡住，则物品只能从侧边进行提取或输入
使用时钟轴承移动结构

translations.en_us: Clockwork Bearings attach to blocks in front of them
translations.zh_cn: 时钟轴承会黏着其正面上的方块

translations.en_us: Upon receiving Rotational Force, the structure will be rotated according to the hour of the day
translations.zh_cn: 当接受旋转力时，其附着结构会根据游戏内时间来进行旋转

translations.en_us: Right-Click the bearing to start or stop animating the structure
translations.zh_cn: 右击可以激活/停止结构运动

translations.en_us: In front of the Hour Hand, a second structure can be added
translations.zh_cn: 在时针前方可添加第二个结构

translations.en_us: Ensure that the two Structures are not glued to each other
translations.zh_cn: 请确保这两个结构没有被互相黏合

translations.en_us: The Second Structure will now rotate as the Minute Hand
translations.zh_cn: 第二个结构将会作为分针进行旋转

translations.en_us: Controlling rotational force using a Clutch
translations.zh_cn: 使用离合器控制旋转力

translations.en_us: Clutches will relay rotation in a straight line
translations.zh_cn: 离合器能直线传递旋转力

translations.en_us: When powered by Redstone, it breaks the connection
translations.zh_cn: 当被红石充能时，离合器会断开动力传递

translations.en_us: Large and Small cogs can be connected diagonally
translations.zh_cn: 大齿轮与小齿轮可以斜向传递动力

translations.en_us: Shifting from large to small cogs, the conveyed speed will be doubled
translations.zh_cn: 从大齿轮传递动力至小齿轮时，转速翻倍

translations.en_us: Shifting the opposite way, the conveyed speed will be halved
translations.zh_cn: 从小齿轮传递动力至大齿轮时，转速减半
使用齿轮来传递旋转力

translations.en_us: Cogwheels will relay rotation to other adjacent cogwheels
translations.zh_cn: 齿轮会将动力传递至临近的齿轮

translations.en_us: Neighbouring shafts connected like this will rotate in opposite directions
translations.zh_cn: 以此方式连接的齿轮，旋转方向相反

translations.en_us: Brass or Andesite Casing can be used to decorate Cogwheels
translations.zh_cn: 安山机壳或黄铜机壳，可以用来装饰齿轮

translations.en_us: Components added after encasing will not connect to the shaft outputs
translations.zh_cn: 在装壳后添加的元件将不会与传动杆相连

translations.en_us: The Wrench can be used to toggle connections
Actors on moving contraptions are always active by default
translations.zh_cn: 动态结构上的元件默认情况下总是启用的

translations.en_us: Contraption Controls can be used to toggle them on the fly
translations.zh_cn: 动态结构控制器可以在运动时移动控制它们

translations.en_us: They can be attached anywhere on the contraption
translations.zh_cn: 它们能被放在动态结构中的任何地方

translations.en_us: While disassembled, the filter can be changed to target specific types of actors
translations.zh_cn: 当方块化时，过滤器可以被更改成特定的目标元件

translations.en_us: If it is redstone-activated during assembly...
translations.zh_cn: 当它在实体化时收到了红石信号……

translations.en_us: ...targeted actors will be turned off from the start
translations.zh_cn: ……目标元件将会一开始就被关闭

translations.en_us: Creative Fluid Tanks can be used to provide a bottomless supply of fluid
translations.zh_cn: 创造流体储罐可以提供无限量的流体

translations.en_us: Right-Click with a fluid containing item to configure it
translations.zh_cn: 使用一个含有流体的容器右击它，即可指定它提供特定的流体

translations.en_us: Pipe Networks can now endlessly draw the assigned fluid from the tank
translations.zh_cn: 流体管道可以从中无限提取指定的流体

translations.en_us: Any Fluids pushed back into a Creative Fluid Tank will be voided
translations.zh_cn: 任何被输入创造流体储罐的液体都将被销毁

translations.en_us: Generating Rotational Force using Creative Motors
translations.zh_cn: 使用创造马达产生旋转力

translations.en_us: Creative motors are a compact and configurable source of Rotational Force
translations.zh_cn: 创造马达是一种紧凑且可配置的旋转力源

translations.en_us: The generated speed can be configured on its input panels
translations.zh_cn: 产生的转速可以在它的输入面板上配置

translations.en_us: A pair of Crushing Wheels can grind items very effectively
translations.zh_cn: 一对粉碎轮，磨物快又准

translations.en_us: Their Rotational Input has to make them spin into each other
translations.zh_cn: 接入的旋转必须使得这两个轮子啮合转动

translations.en_us: Items thrown or inserted into the top will get processed
translations.zh_cn: 扔入或者放入的物品都会被粉碎处理

translations.en_us: Items can be inserted and picked up through automated means as well
translations.zh_cn: 你也可以使用自动化方案进行物品的输入与取出

translations.en_us: Given Rotational Force, a Deployer can imitate player interactions
translations.zh_cn: 接入旋转力，机械手便可以模仿玩家的交互行为

translations.en_us: Right-click the front to give it an Item to use
translations.zh_cn: 对着机械手的前部右击，即可将手上的物品给予它使用

translations.en_us: Items can also be inserted automatically
translations.zh_cn: 物品也可以自动化输入到机械手内
机械手附带一个过滤槽

translations.en_us: When a filter is set, it activates only while holding a matching item
translations.zh_cn: 设定了过滤后，只有它手中的物品与过滤相匹配时，它才会工作

translations.en_us: Only items matching the filter can now be inserted...
translations.zh_cn: 只有与过滤匹配的物品才可输入……

translations.en_us: ...and only non-matching items will be extracted
translations.zh_cn: ……只有不匹配的物品可被抽取出来

translations.en_us: It will always interact with the position 2 blocks in front of itself
translations.zh_cn: 它只会与它正前方第 2 格处的位置进行交互

translations.en_us: Blocks directly in front will not obstruct it
translations.zh_cn: 放在在它面前的方块不会阻拦它的工作

translations.en_us: Whenever Deployers are moved as part of an animated Contraption...
translations.zh_cn: 当机械手在动态结构上时……

translations.en_us: They activate at each visited location, using items from inventories anywhere on the contraption
translations.zh_cn: 机械手会对每一个经过的方块使用结构中任意容器内的物品

translations.en_us: The Filter slot can be used to specify which items to pull
translations.zh_cn: 过滤槽可用于指定要抽取的物品

translations.en_us: By default, a Deployer imitates a Right-click interaction
translations.zh_cn: 在默认情况下，机械手模仿玩家的右击交互

translations.en_us: Using a Wrench, it can be set to imitate a Left-click instead
translations.zh_cn: 使用扳手可以将模式调整为模仿玩家的左击交互

translations.en_us: With a fitting held item, Deployers can process items provided beneath them
translations.zh_cn: 当机械手持有合适的物品时，它可以自动处理下方的物品

translations.en_us: The Input items can be dropped or placed on a Depot under the Deployer
translations.zh_cn: 物品可以被丢在机械手下方，或放在置物台上

translations.en_us: When items are provided on a belt...
translations.zh_cn: 当传送带上的物品经过机械手下方时……

translations.en_us: The Deployer will hold and process them automatically
translations.zh_cn: ……机械手会使物品停下，然后处理这个物品

translations.en_us: When powered by Redstone, Deployers will not activate
translations.zh_cn: 当被红石充能时，机械手会停止工作

translations.en_us: Before stopping, the Deployer will finish any started cycles
translations.zh_cn: 在停止工作前，机械手会完成当前正在进行的工作周期

translations.en_us: Thus, a negative pulse can be used to trigger exactly one activation cycle
translations.zh_cn: 因此，通入单次负红石脉冲可以精确控制机械手，使其每次只进行单个周期的工作

translations.en_us: Depots can serve as 'stationary' belt elements
translations.zh_cn: 置物台可以被当成一个“静止的”传送带原件使用

translations.en_us: Right-Click to manually place or remove Items from it
translations.zh_cn: 右击可以手动放置或取下物品

translations.en_us: Just like Mechanical Belts, it can provide items to processing
translations.zh_cn: 与传送带一样，它也可以将其内的物品转送到其他设备中进行加工……

translations.en_us: ...as well as provide Items to Mechanical Arms
translations.zh_cn: ……同时物品也可以被机械手存取

translations.en_us: Display Boards are a scalable alternative to the sign
translations.zh_cn: 翻牌显示器是告示牌的可扩展替代品

translations.en_us: They require Rotational Force to operate
translations.zh_cn: 它们需要旋转力以供运作

translations.en_us: Static text can be applied using written Clipboards
translations.zh_cn: 可以使用已书写的剪贴板设置静态文本

translations.en_us: And dynamic text through the use of Display Links
translations.zh_cn: 使用显示链接器显示动态文本

translations.en_us: Dyes can be applied to individual lines of the board
translations.zh_cn: 可以使用染料来改变单行的颜色

translations.en_us: Lines can be reset by clicking them with an empty hand
translations.zh_cn: 可以通过空手点击来重置单行内容

translations.en_us: Display Links can be used to visualise dynamic information
translations.zh_cn: 显示链接器可用于可视化动态信息

translations.en_us: ...then attach it to the block to read from
translations.zh_cn: ……然后将其连接到要读取的方块上

translations.en_us: Open the Interface to select and configure what is sent
translations.zh_cn: 打开界面选择和配置要发送的内容

translations.en_us: The display will now receive information from the link
translations.zh_cn: 显示器现在将接收其上的信息

translations.en_us: Not every block can act as a source
translations.zh_cn: 不是所有方块都可以作为信息源

translations.en_us: Each compatible block provides unique information
translations.zh_cn: 每个兼容的方块都提供了独特的信息

translations.en_us: The Display Link can work with several different displays
translations.zh_cn: 显示链接器可以在很多“显示器”上生效

translations.en_us: When powered by Redstone, Display Links stop sending updates
translations.zh_cn: 当被红石充能时，显示链接器将停止发送新信息

translations.en_us: Once unpowered, the Timer is reset and new info is sent immediately
translations.zh_cn: 一旦红石信号断开，计时器就会重置，并立即发送新信息

translations.en_us: Signals emitted from the source do not affect the Link
translations.zh_cn: 信息源方块发出的红石信号不会影响链接器

translations.en_us: Elevator Pulleys can move structures vertically between marked locations
translations.zh_cn: 升降机滑轮可以在已标记的位置之间垂直移动结构

translations.en_us: Any redstone contact sharing this column will be converted
translations.zh_cn: 所有在此列的接触式红石信号发生器会被转化

translations.en_us: Supply a redstone pulse to call the elevator to the contact
translations.zh_cn: 对升降机锚点通入红石信号以召唤轿厢

translations.en_us: The movement speed depends on the rotation input on the pulley
translations.zh_cn: 移动速度取决于输入滑轮的转速

translations.en_us: Scroll and click on the controls block to choose a floor while on-board
translations.zh_cn: 滚动并单击控制方块以选择楼层

translations.en_us: Right-Clicking the assembled pulley will turn the cabin back into blocks
translations.zh_cn: 右击已组装的滑轮来将轿厢方块化

translations.en_us: Sliding doors attached to the cabin will open and close automatically
translations.zh_cn: 升降机上的滑动门会自动打开和关闭

translations.en_us: Elevator Contacts emit a signal while the cabin is on their floor
translations.zh_cn: 当轿厢到达某楼层，该楼层的升降机锚点会发出信号

translations.en_us: This can be useful to trigger doors or special effects upon arrival
translations.zh_cn: 这可能有助于在到达时触发门或者其他特殊效果

translations.en_us: Display Links on any of the contacts can show the current floor of the elevator
translations.zh_cn: 显示链接器安装在任何升降机锚点上都能显示目前轿厢所在的楼层
开始建造你的升降机轿厢

translations.en_us: Place a pair of Redstone Contacts facing each other...
translations.zh_cn: 放置一对面对面的接触式红石信号发生器……

translations.en_us: ...and glue one of them to your moving structure
translations.zh_cn: ……并且把其中一个附着到你的动态结构上

translations.en_us: Contraption Controls can be attached to make floor selection easier
translations.zh_cn: 安装动态结构控制器以便于选择楼层

translations.en_us: Ensure that the pulley is supplied with Rotational Power
translations.zh_cn: 确保升降机滑轮接入了动力

translations.en_us: Right-Clicking the pulley assembles the elevator
translations.zh_cn: 右击升降机滑轮以组装升降机

translations.en_us: The stationary contact now turns into an Elevator Contact
translations.zh_cn: 现在静止的接触式红石信号发生器转变成了一个升降机锚点

translations.en_us: Elevator Contacts represent a 'floor' and can be configured
translations.zh_cn: 升降机锚点代表一个“楼层”，且可以被配置

translations.en_us: Whenever a pulley assembles a contraption...
translations.zh_cn: 当使用一个滑轮组装了一个动态结构……

translations.en_us: ...other pulleys on the same layer will connect to the structure
translations.zh_cn: ……同一高度的其他滑轮也会被连接到结构上

translations.en_us: They do not require to be powered, the effect is purely cosmetic
translations.zh_cn: 它们不需要接入动力，且只有装饰效果
使用空的烈焰人燃烧室

translations.en_us: Right-click a Blaze with the empty burner to capture it
translations.zh_cn: 手持空的烈焰人燃烧室右击烈焰人来抓取烈焰人

translations.en_us: Alternatively, Blazes can be collected from their Spawners directly
translations.zh_cn: 或者，可以直接从烈焰人刷怪笼中收集烈焰人

translations.en_us: You now have an ideal heat source for various machines
translations.zh_cn: 这样，你便有了一个可供部分机器加工的热源

translations.en_us: For Aesthetic purposes, Empty Blaze Burners can also be lit using Flint and Steel
translations.zh_cn: 如果是为了美观，空的烈焰人燃烧室也可以被打火石点燃

translations.en_us: The flame can be transformed using a soul-infused item
translations.zh_cn: 你可以使用注入了灵魂的物品转化这种火焰

translations.en_us: However, without a blaze they are not suitable for industrial heating
translations.zh_cn: 但是，没有烈焰人，这样的火焰并不足以用于工业级加热工作

translations.en_us: Copper Casing can be used to decorate Fluid Pipes
translations.zh_cn: 铜机壳可以用于装饰流体管道

translations.en_us: Aside from being concealed, Encased Pipes are locked into their connectivity state
translations.zh_cn: 除了遮掩流体管道之外，装壳的流体管道将不再改变其连接状态

translations.en_us: It will no longer react to any neighbouring blocks being added or removed
translations.zh_cn: 它将不会对旁边新放置或移除的管道做出反应
使用工厂仪表自动化动力合成

translations.en_us: Factory gauges provide auto-arrangement for crafting table recipes
translations.zh_cn: 工厂仪表可以自动调配动力合成器的配方

translations.en_us: Connect the required ingredients as before
translations.zh_cn: 将所需原材料像之前那样连接

translations.en_us: When a valid recipe is detected, a new button appears in the UI
translations.zh_cn: 当检测到一个有效配方时，在界面中会出现一个新的按钮

translations.en_us: With auto-arrangement active, the boxes can be unwrapped into crafters directly
translations.zh_cn: 当自动调配启用时，包裹可被自动解包至动力合成器

translations.en_us: The setup must be 3x3 and the crafters have to be connected via wrench
translations.zh_cn: 配方必须为 3×3 大小且动力合成器需要使用扳手连接

translations.en_us: Hold Right-click on the gauge to set the target amount
translations.zh_cn: 对着仪表长按右键以设置目标数量

translations.en_us: This crafter can now be used universally, by more gauges with different recipes
translations.zh_cn: 现在可以通过多个不同配方的仪表来实现通用合成

translations.en_us: Outputs should be sent back to a linked inventory to close the loop
translations.zh_cn: 输出必须送回一个连接的仓库中以结束循环

translations.en_us: Using a Re-packager is recommended to prevent fragmentation of input packages
translations.zh_cn: 推荐使用理包机以避免多个包裹输入造成的错误
将仪表连接到其他方块

translations.en_us: When adding a new connection from the UI...
translations.zh_cn: 当在界面中添加新连接时……

translations.en_us: ...the gauge also accepts Redstone and Display Links
translations.zh_cn: ……仪表也接受无线红石终端和显示链接器

translations.en_us: Redstone links will be powered when the stock level is at or above the target amount
translations.zh_cn: 当库存物品数量达到或超过目标数量时，将会输出红石信号

translations.en_us: In receiver mode, links can stop the gauge from sending requests
translations.zh_cn: 接收模式的无线红石终端可以阻止仪表发送请求

translations.en_us: Display links can provide a status overview of connected gauges
translations.zh_cn: 显示链接器可以提供已连接仪表的状态概要
使用工厂仪表自动化生产

translations.en_us: Whenever gauges are not placed on a packager...
translations.zh_cn: 当仪表没有被放置在打包机上时……

translations.en_us: Specify the address that ingredients should be sent to
translations.zh_cn: 指定原料应被发送到的地址

translations.en_us: The target amount to maintain can now be set by holding Right-click on the gauge
translations.zh_cn: 对仪表按住右键以设置目标数量

translations.en_us: Whenever the network has fewer items than the amount...
translations.zh_cn: 当网络中的物品数量少于其标记数量……

translations.en_us: ...it will send new ingredients to the specified address
translations.zh_cn: ……它将向指定的地址发送新的原材料

translations.en_us: The outputs then need to return to any of the linked inventories
translations.zh_cn: 输出的物品随后需要返回任一已经连接的仓库中

translations.en_us: Green connections indicate that the target amount has been reached
translations.zh_cn: 绿色连接代表目标数量已经达成

translations.en_us: The board of gauges can expand to include more recipe steps
translations.zh_cn: 仪表的控制范围可以扩展到更多步骤的合成

translations.en_us: Each gauge maintains the stock level of its item independently
translations.zh_cn: 每一个仪表都只会单独检测某种物品的存储数量

translations.en_us: They will instead monitor stock levels of all linked inventories
translations.zh_cn: 它们将监测所有已连接的存储中物品的库存数量

translations.en_us: Right-click it with the item that should be monitored
translations.zh_cn: 手持物品右击以监测该物品

translations.en_us: It will now display the total amount present on the network
translations.zh_cn: 它将显示网络中此物品的总数量

translations.en_us: The gauge can replenish stock levels by sending other items to be processed
translations.zh_cn: 仪表可以通过发送该物品的合成配方以补充库存水平

translations.en_us: First, add the required ingredients as new factory gauges
translations.zh_cn: 首先，在新的仪表中添加合成材料

translations.en_us: From the target's UI, new connections can be made
translations.zh_cn: 在目标界面中，可以建立新的连接

translations.en_us: For aesthetics, input panels can be wrenched to change the pathing
translations.zh_cn: 输入面板可以使用扳手更改路径使其更加美观

translations.en_us: In the UI, review the inputs and specify how much of the output gets made per batch
translations.zh_cn: 在界面中，查看输入并指定每批次输出的数量
使用工厂仪表进行补货

translations.en_us: Right-click a Stock link before placement to connect to its network
translations.zh_cn: 放置前，右击一个仓储链接站以连接至整个网络

translations.en_us: ...the logistics network sends more, with the specified address
translations.zh_cn: ……物流网络系统会向指定的地址发送更多物品

translations.en_us: From there, they can be routed to the packager
translations.zh_cn: 然后，它们可以路由到打包机中

translations.en_us: When placed on a packager, factory gauges can monitor items inside the inventory
translations.zh_cn: 当被放置在打包机上时，工厂仪表可以检测库存内的物品

translations.en_us: Right-click it with the item that should be monitored
translations.zh_cn: 手持物品右击以监测该物品

translations.en_us: It will now display the amount present in the inventory
translations.zh_cn: 它将显示库存中此物品的数量

translations.en_us: The gauge can refill this inventory from the logistics network
translations.zh_cn: 仪表可以从物流网络中向库存输入物品

translations.en_us: Right-click it again to open its configuration UI
translations.zh_cn: 对其再次右击以打开它的配置界面

translations.en_us: Set an address that should be used for the requested items
translations.zh_cn: 设置一个用来请求物品的地址

translations.en_us: The target amount to maintain can now be set by holding Right-click on the gauge
translations.zh_cn: 对仪表按住右键以设置目标数量

translations.en_us: Whenever the chest has fewer items than this amount...
translations.zh_cn: 当箱子中的物品数量少于目标数量时……

translations.en_us: Encased Fans use Rotational Force to create an Air Current
translations.zh_cn: 鼓风机使用旋转力来制造气流

translations.en_us: Strength and Direction of Flow depends on the Rotational Input
translations.zh_cn: 流速以及方向取决于旋转力来源的强弱以及方向

translations.en_us: When passing through lava, the Air Flow becomes Heated
translations.zh_cn: 当气流吹过熔岩时，气流会被加热

translations.en_us: Items caught in the area will be smelted
translations.zh_cn: 热气流中的物品会被冶炼

translations.en_us: Food items thrown here would be incinerated
translations.zh_cn: 但在气流中的食物会被直接烧成灰

translations.en_us: Instead, a setup for Smoking using Fire should be used for them
translations.zh_cn: 而想要烹饪食物，必须要通过吹过火焰的气流来烟熏食物

translations.en_us: Air Flows passing through water create a Washing Setup
translations.zh_cn: 当气流吹过水后，便可用于洗涤物品

translations.en_us: Some interesting new processing can be done with it
translations.zh_cn: 这种加工方法可以做到不少有趣的事情

translations.en_us: The Speed of the Fan does NOT affect the processing speed, only its range
translations.zh_cn: 鼓风机的转速对加工的速度没有影响，只影响气流的吹拂距离

translations.en_us: Fan Processing can also be applied to Items on Depots and Belts
translations.zh_cn: 而那些放置在置物台或者传送带上的物品，鼓风机也是可以处理的

translations.en_us: Fluid Pipes can connect two or more fluid sources and targets
translations.zh_cn: 流体管道可以用于连接两个或多个流体容器

translations.en_us: Using a wrench, a straight pipe segment can be given a window
translations.zh_cn: 使用扳手，可以为直管道安装观察窗

translations.en_us: Windowed pipes will not connect to any other adjacent pipe segments
translations.zh_cn: 带有观察窗的管道无法建立侧向管道连接

translations.en_us: Powered by Mechanical Pumps, the Pipes can transport Fluids
translations.zh_cn: 使用动力泵，流体管道可以传输流体

translations.en_us: No fluid is being extracted at first
translations.zh_cn: 一开始，流体不会真正地被抽出

translations.en_us: Once the flow connects them, the endpoints gradually transfer their contents
translations.zh_cn: 只有当管道内的流体流彻底连通之后，流体才会开始逐渐从一个容器中转移到另一个中

translations.en_us: Thus, the Pipe blocks themselves never 'physically' contain any fluid
translations.zh_cn: 这意味着流体管道本身并不真正存储任何流体

translations.en_us: Endpoints of a pipe network can interact with a variety of blocks
translations.zh_cn: 流体管道的末端可以与许多种容器连接

translations.en_us: Any block with fluid storage capabilities can be filled or drained
translations.zh_cn: 任何可以容纳流体的容器都可以被填充或从中抽取

translations.en_us: Source blocks right in front of an open end can be picked up...
translations.zh_cn: 开放的管道口可以吸走流体源方块……

translations.en_us: ...while spilling into empty spaces can create fluid sources
Pipes can also extract fluids from a handful of other blocks directly
translations.zh_cn: 管道也可以从许多种其他方块中直接抽取流体

translations.en_us: Fluid Tanks can be combined to increase the total capacity
translations.zh_cn: 流体储罐可以多格连接，提供更大的存储量

translations.en_us: Their base square can be up to 3 blocks wide...
translations.zh_cn: 流体储罐的最大横截面为 3×3……

translations.en_us: ...and grow in height by more than 30 additional layers
Using a Wrench, a tanks' window can be toggled
translations.zh_cn: 使用扳手可以打开或关闭观察窗
使用流体储罐存储流体

translations.en_us: Fluid Tanks can be used to store large amounts of fluid
translations.zh_cn: 流体储罐可以存储大量的流体

translations.en_us: Pipe networks can push and pull fluids from any side
translations.zh_cn: 流体管道可以在流体储罐的任何一面将流体输入/输出

translations.en_us: The contained fluid can be measured by a Comparator
translations.zh_cn: 使用比较器可以检测储罐中的流体储量

translations.en_us: However, in Survival Mode Fluids cannot be added or taken manually
translations.zh_cn: 在生存模式中，无法直接用容器向储罐中存入或取出流体

translations.en_us: You can use Basins, Item Drains and Spouts to drain or fill fluid containing items
translations.zh_cn: 要装满/倒空流体容器，可以使用工作盆，分液池或注液器

translations.en_us: Funnels should also interact nicely with a handful of other components.
translations.zh_cn: 漏斗可以与一些其他元件互动。

translations.en_us: Placed normally, it pulls items from the inventory.
translations.zh_cn: 直接放置时，漏斗会将物品从容器中取出

translations.en_us: Placed while sneaking, it puts items into the inventory.
translations.zh_cn: 潜行放置时，漏斗会将物品置入容器中

translations.en_us: Using a wrench, the funnel can be flipped after placement.
translations.zh_cn: 使用扳手可以改变漏斗的存/取模式

translations.en_us: Same rules will apply for most orientations.
translations.zh_cn: 相同的规则适用于大多数朝向。

translations.en_us: Funnels on belts will extract/insert depending on its movement direction.
translations.zh_cn: 在传送带末端放置的漏斗会根据传送带的传动方向存/取物品

translations.en_us: Funnels are ideal for transferring items from and to inventories.
translations.zh_cn: 用漏斗来存取容器内的物品，可谓又快又好

translations.en_us: Redstone power will prevent any funnel from acting
translations.zh_cn: 红石信号会使漏斗停止工作

translations.en_us: Funnels cannot ever transfer between closed inventories directly.
translations.zh_cn: 漏斗不能在闭合容器之间直接传输物品

translations.en_us: Chutes or Smart chutes might be more suitable for such purposes.
translations.zh_cn: 溜槽和智能溜槽更适用于这样的场景。

translations.en_us: Same applies for horizontal movement. A mechanical belt should help here.
translations.zh_cn: 水平传输也是如此，也许传送带更方便快捷

translations.en_us: Gantry Carriages can mount to and slide along a Gantry Shaft.
translations.zh_cn: 起重机取物器可以被放置在起重机杆上，并且可以沿着起重机杆运动

translations.en_us: Gantry setups can move attached Blocks.
translations.zh_cn: 起重机可以移动其黏着的方块。

translations.en_us: Gantry shafts attach to a carriage without the need of super glue
translations.zh_cn: 无需强力胶，起重机取物器便可与起重机杆相连

translations.en_us: Same applies for carriages on moved Gantry Shafts
translations.zh_cn: 即使是在移动的起重机杆上也是如此

translations.en_us: Thus, a gantry system can be cascaded to cover multiple axes of movement
translations.zh_cn: 因此，起重机系统可以串联起来，如此可以影响到多轴向的运动

translations.en_us: Gantry Shafts can have opposite orientations
translations.zh_cn: 起重机杆可以有相反的方向

translations.en_us: The movement direction of carriages depend on their shafts' orientation
translations.zh_cn: 起重机取物器的移动方向取决于起重机杆的方向

translations.en_us: ...as well as the rotation direction of the shaft
Same rules apply for the propagated rotation
translations.zh_cn: 在旋转传递中，此规则同样适用

translations.en_us: Redstone-powered gantry shafts stop moving their carriages
translations.zh_cn: 被红石信号激活的起重机杆，将不会移动其上的取物器

translations.en_us: Instead, its rotational force is relayed to the carriages' output shaft
translations.zh_cn: 作为替代，杆上的旋转力会传递到取物器的输出杆上

translations.en_us: Gantry Shafts form the basis of a gantry setup. Attached Carriages will move along them.
translations.zh_cn: 起重机杆组成了起重机系统的基础，与其相接的取物器可以沿着杆进行移动

translations.en_us: Gantry setups can move attached Blocks.
translations.zh_cn: 起重机系统可以移动与其相接的方块
使用十字齿轮箱传递旋转力

translations.en_us: Jumping between axes of rotation can get bulky quickly
translations.zh_cn: 更改旋转轴向，很容易使得整个旋转体系变得臃肿不堪

translations.en_us: A gearbox is the more compact equivalent of this setup
translations.zh_cn: 十字齿轮箱则是替代方案，它的体积更为小巧紧凑

translations.en_us: Shafts around corners rotate in mirrored directions
translations.zh_cn: 垂直相邻的传动杆，旋转方向呈镜像
直线连接的传动杆，旋转方向相反

translations.en_us: Controlling rotational force using a Gearshift
translations.zh_cn: 使用反转齿轮箱控制旋转力

translations.en_us: Gearshifts will relay rotation in a straight line
translations.zh_cn: 反转齿轮箱可以直线传输旋转

translations.en_us: When powered by Redstone, it reverses the transmission
translations.zh_cn: 当被红石充能时，输出端的旋转方向会被反转

translations.en_us: Generating Rotational Force using Hand Cranks
translations.zh_cn: 使用手摇曲柄产生旋转力

translations.en_us: Hand Cranks can be used by players to apply rotational force manually
translations.zh_cn: 玩家可以使用手摇曲柄来手动产生旋转力

translations.en_us: Hold Right-Click to rotate it Counter-Clockwise
translations.zh_cn: 按住右键可以逆时针旋转它

translations.en_us: Sneak and Hold Right-Click to rotate it Clockwise
translations.zh_cn: 潜行并右击可使它顺时针旋转

translations.en_us: Source Filling and Draining using Hose Pulleys
translations.zh_cn: 使用软管滑轮抽取或排放流体

translations.en_us: Hose Pulleys can be used to fill or drain large bodies of Fluid
translations.zh_cn: 软管滑轮可以用于方便地对一个较大区域进行抽取流体或填满流体的操作

translations.en_us: With the Kinetic Input, the height of the pulleys' hose can be controlled
translations.zh_cn: 通过输入动力可以调节软管末端的高度

translations.en_us: The Pulley retracts while the input rotation is inverted
translations.zh_cn: 反转动力输入的方向可以收起软管

translations.en_us: On the opposite side, pipes can be connected
translations.zh_cn: 管道可以连接在另一侧

translations.en_us: Attached pipe networks can either provide fluid to the hose...
translations.zh_cn: 连接的管道可以将流体输入到软管滑轮中，软管会在下方排出口处放置流体源……

translations.en_us: ...or pull from it, draining the pool instead
translations.zh_cn: ……或者提供吸力来抽取世界中的流体

translations.en_us: Fill and Drain speed of the pulley depends entirely on the fluid networks' throughput
translations.zh_cn: 软管滑轮的抽取/排放速度取决于连接管道中流体的流速

translations.en_us: Passively Filling and Draining large bodies of Fluid
translations.zh_cn: 被动抽取和排放大体量流体

translations.en_us: When deploying the Hose Pulley into a large enough ocean...
translations.zh_cn: 当软管被放进足够大的流体中时……

translations.en_us: It will provide/dispose fluids without affecting the source
translations.zh_cn: ……它在抽取或排放流体时将不会影响流体源

translations.en_us: Pipe networks can limitlessly take fluids from/to such pulleys
translations.zh_cn: 可以从这些软管滑轮中无限量地抽取或向其排放流体

translations.en_us: Fill and Drain level of Hose Pulleys
translations.zh_cn: 软管滑轮的排水/抽水机制

translations.en_us: While fully retracted, the Hose Pulley cannot operate
translations.zh_cn: 当软管彻底收回时，软管滑轮无法工作

translations.en_us: Draining runs from top to bottom
translations.zh_cn: 抽取流体的顺序为由上至下

translations.en_us: The surface level will end up just below where the hose ends
translations.zh_cn: 流体表面最终将会被抽取到刚好低于软管开口

translations.en_us: Filling runs from bottom to top
translations.zh_cn: 填充流体的顺序为由下至上

translations.en_us: The filled pool will not grow beyond the layer above the hose end
translations.zh_cn: 流体最多只能被填充至软管开口所在的高度

translations.en_us: Emptying Fluid Containers using Item Drains
translations.zh_cn: 使用分液池提取物品中的流体

translations.en_us: Item Drains can extract fluids from items
translations.zh_cn: 分液池可以提取物品中的流体

translations.en_us: Right-click it to pour fluids from your held item into it
translations.zh_cn: 右击可以将手持物品中的流体倒入分液池中

translations.en_us: When items are inserted from the side...
...they roll across, emptying out their contained fluid
translations.zh_cn: ……物品将会滚过分液池顶部，并在此过程中将其包含的流体排入分液池内

translations.en_us: Pipe Networks can now pull the fluid from the drains' internal buffer
translations.zh_cn: 流体管道可以从分液池中抽取流体

translations.en_us: Item Vaults can be combined to increase the total capacity
translations.zh_cn: 可以组合物品保险库以增加总容量

translations.en_us: Their base square can be up to 3 blocks wide...
translations.zh_cn: 它们的直径最多可以有 3 个方块宽……

translations.en_us: ...and grow in length up to 3x their diameter
Item Vaults can be used to store large amounts of items
translations.zh_cn: 物品保险库可以存储大量的物品

translations.en_us: However, contents cannot be added or taken manually
translations.zh_cn: 但是，不能手动添加或获取物品

translations.en_us: Any components for item transfer can both insert...
translations.zh_cn: 任何用于物品传输的元件都可以用于添加……

translations.en_us: Relaying rotational force using Large Cogwheels
translations.zh_cn: 使用大齿轮传递旋转力

translations.en_us: Large cogwheels can connect to each other at right angles
translations.zh_cn: 大齿轮可以从特定的角度相互连接

translations.en_us: It will help relaying conveyed speed to other axes of rotation
translations.zh_cn: 可以利用大齿轮变更旋转轴向

translations.en_us: Generating Rotational Force using Large Water Wheels
translations.zh_cn: 使用大水车产生旋转力

translations.en_us: Large Water Wheels draw force from adjacent Water Currents
translations.zh_cn: 大水车利用相邻的水流来产生旋转力

translations.en_us: Covering additional sides will not improve its kinetic output further
translations.zh_cn: 覆盖其他侧面不会进一步增加其动力输出

translations.en_us: These rotate only at half the speed of regular water wheels...
translations.zh_cn: 它的旋转速度只有普通水车的一半……

translations.en_us: ...but provide a substantially higher stress capacity
translations.zh_cn: ……但是大幅提高了应力生产能力

translations.en_us: Use wood planks on the wheel to change its appearance
translations.zh_cn: 对水车使用木板以改变其外观
使用轴向底盘黏合方块

translations.en_us: The open faces of a Linear Chassis can be made Sticky
translations.zh_cn: 它的外露面可以变为黏性面

translations.en_us: Click again to make the opposite side sticky
translations.zh_cn: 再次点击黏性面，可以将它的对面也变得具有黏性

translations.en_us: Sneak and Right-Click with an empty hand to remove the slime
translations.zh_cn: 空手潜行右击可以移除此面的黏性物

translations.en_us: Stickied faces of the Linear Chassis will attach a line of blocks in front of it
translations.zh_cn: 黏性面可以将此面前方的一长条方块黏住

translations.en_us: Using a Wrench, a precise Range can be specified for this chassis
translations.zh_cn: 使用扳手可以精确控制底盘的影响范围

translations.en_us: Holding CTRL adjusts the range of all connected Chassis Blocks
translations.zh_cn: 按住 Ctrl 以调节所有底盘的影响范围

translations.en_us: Attaching blocks to any other side requires the use of Super Glue
translations.zh_cn: 若想让底盘的其他面也能粘方块，你需要用到强力胶

translations.en_us: Using these mechanics, structures of any shape can move as a Contraption
translations.zh_cn: 利用这些机制，任何形状的结构都可以作为动态结构移动

translations.en_us: Linear Chassis connect to identical Chassis blocks next to them
translations.zh_cn: 相邻的轴向底盘可以相互连接在一起

translations.en_us: When one is moved by a Contraption, the others are dragged with it
translations.zh_cn: 其中的一个底盘若被移动，其余的底盘也会跟着移动

translations.en_us: Chassis of a different type or facing another direction will not attach
translations.zh_cn: 不同种类的底盘，或者是朝向不一致的底盘，将不会相连

translations.en_us: Mechanical Arms have to be assigned their in- and outputs before they are placed
translations.zh_cn: 你得在放置动力臂之前就配置好它的输入以及输出端

translations.en_us: Right-Click inventories while holding the Arm to assign them as Targets
translations.zh_cn: 手持动力臂右击某个容器，可以将其指定为目标

translations.en_us: Right-Click again to toggle between Input (Blue) and Output (Yellow)
translations.zh_cn: 再次右击可以使其在输入端（蓝色）以及输出端（黄色）之间切换

translations.en_us: Left-Click components to remove their Selection
translations.zh_cn: 左击此元件可以移除选择

translations.en_us: Once placed, the Mechanical Arm will target the blocks selected previously
translations.zh_cn: 将动力臂放下来后，它会将此前选择的方块作为目标

translations.en_us: They can have any amount of in- and outputs within their range
translations.zh_cn: 在有效范围内，动力臂可以有任意数量的输出以及输入端

translations.en_us: However, not every type of Inventory can be interacted with directly
translations.zh_cn: 然而，并不是所有的容器可以被直接交互

translations.en_us: Funnels and Depots can help to Bridge that gap
translations.zh_cn: 在此情况下，漏斗和置物台可以解决此问题

translations.en_us: Filtering Outputs of the Mechanical Arm
Sometimes it is desirable to restrict targets of the Arm by matching a filter
translations.zh_cn: 有时，你会想着利用某种过滤限制动力臂的目标

translations.en_us: Mechanical Arms by themselves do not provide any options for filtering
translations.zh_cn: 动力臂自身并不提供任何过滤选项

translations.en_us: Brass Funnels as Targets do however communicate their own filter to the Arm
translations.zh_cn: 然而，若将黄铜漏斗作为目标，则漏斗的过滤槽可以应用至动力臂上

translations.en_us: The Arm is smart enough not to pick up items it couldn't distribute
translations.zh_cn: 动力臂足够智能，它不会去拿取那些它无法分配的物品

translations.en_us: Distribution modes of the Mechanical Arm
Whenever an Arm has to choose between multiple valid outputs...
translations.zh_cn: 若动力臂必须在数个有效的输出端之间作出选择……

translations.en_us: ...it will act according to its setting
translations.zh_cn: ……它会依照自己的设定选择特定的行为

translations.en_us: The value panel will allow you to configure it
translations.zh_cn: 面板允许您对其进行配置

translations.en_us: Round Robin mode simply cycles through all outputs that are available
translations.zh_cn: “轮询调度”模式很好理解，即循环输出至所有有效的输出端

translations.en_us: If an output is unable to take more items, it will be skipped
translations.zh_cn: 如果某个输出端无法容纳更多物品，则它会被跳过

translations.en_us: Forced Round Robin mode will never skip outputs, and instead wait until they are free
translations.zh_cn: “强制轮询调度”不会跳过任何输出端，动力臂会一直等待，直到输出端有空位容纳物品输入

translations.en_us: Prefer First prioritizes the outputs selected earliest when configuring this Arm
translations.zh_cn: “第一目标优先”模式会使得动力臂先将物品输出至更早被选择的输出端
利用红石信号控制动力臂

translations.en_us: When powered by Redstone, Mechanical Arms will not activate
translations.zh_cn: 当被红石充能时，动力臂会停止工作

translations.en_us: Before stopping, it will finish any started cycles
translations.zh_cn: 在停止工作前，它会完成当前正在进行的工作周期

translations.en_us: Thus, a negative pulse can be used to trigger exactly one activation cycle
translations.zh_cn: 因此，通入单次负红石脉冲可以精确控制动力臂，使其每次只进行单个周期的工作

translations.en_us: Moving Structures using the Mechanical Bearing
translations.zh_cn: 使用动力轴承移动结构

translations.en_us: Mechanical Bearings attach to the block in front of them
translations.zh_cn: 动力轴承会黏着其正面上的方块

translations.en_us: Upon receiving Rotational Force, it will assemble it into a Rotating Contraption
translations.zh_cn: 接收到旋转力后，它会将这一黏合结构组装为旋转结构

translations.en_us: An array of Mechanical Crafters can be used to automate any Crafting Recipe
translations.zh_cn: 动力合成器阵列可用于自动化任何合成配方的制作

translations.en_us: Using a Wrench, the Crafters' paths can be arranged
translations.zh_cn: 使用扳手可以调控合成器的合成通路

translations.en_us: For a valid setup, all paths have to converge into one exit at any side
translations.zh_cn: 所有的合成通路必须汇集到任意一侧的一个出口，整套合成器方可算是设置正确

translations.en_us: The outputs will be placed into the inventory at the exit
translations.zh_cn: 输出产物会被放入位于出口的容器中

translations.en_us: Mechanical Crafters require Rotational Force to operate
translations.zh_cn: 动力合成器的运转需要旋转力的供应

translations.en_us: Right-Click the front to insert Items manually
translations.zh_cn: 右击合成器正面，可以手动放入物品

translations.en_us: Once every slot of a path contains an Item, the crafting process will begin
translations.zh_cn: 一旦合成通路上的所有合成槽位都有了物品，合成就会开始

translations.en_us: For recipes not fully occupying the crafter setup, the start can be forced using a Redstone Pulse
translations.zh_cn: 而对于那些没有完全占满所有合成器槽位的配方，你可以通入红石信号强制开启合成
连接动力合成器的容器

translations.en_us: Items can be inserted to Crafters automatically
translations.zh_cn: 合成器可以自动接受向其输入的物品

translations.en_us: Using the Wrench at their backs, Mechanical Crafter inputs can be combined
translations.zh_cn: 对其背面使用扳手，可以连接合成器

translations.en_us: All connected Crafters can now be accessed by the same input location
translations.zh_cn: 所有相连的合成器可以访问同一个位置的输入
盖住动力合成器的合成槽

translations.en_us: Some recipes will require additional Crafters to bridge gaps in the path
translations.zh_cn: 有些配方需要额外的合成器，来补足合成通路上的间隙

translations.en_us: Using Slot Covers, Crafters can be set to act as an Empty Slot in the arrangement
translations.zh_cn: 使用合成槽盖板，合成器在合成时的行为就如同一个空的合成槽位

translations.en_us: Shared Inputs created with the Wrench at the back can also reach across covered Crafters
translations.zh_cn: 使用扳手在背面创建的的共享输入也可以跨越有盖的合成器

translations.en_us: Breaking Blocks with the Mechanical Drill
translations.zh_cn: 使用动力钻头破坏方块

translations.en_us: When given Rotational Force, a Mechanical Drill will break blocks directly in front of it
translations.zh_cn: 向其通入旋转力后，动力钻头会破坏它面前的方块

translations.en_us: Its mining speed depends on the Rotational Input
translations.zh_cn: 它的挖掘速度取决于通入的旋转速度
在结构中使用动力钻头

translations.en_us: Whenever Drills are moved as part of an animated Contraption...
translations.zh_cn: 当钻头作为动态结构的一部分移动时……

translations.en_us: ...they will break blocks the contraption runs them into

translations.zh_cn: 在动态结构中使用动力收割机

translations.en_us: Whenever Harvesters are moved as part of an animated Contraption...
translations.zh_cn: 当动力收割机作为动态结构的一部分移动时……

translations.en_us: They will harvest and reset any mature crops on their way
translations.zh_cn: 它会采收其路径上的作物，并重置这些作物的生长进度

translations.en_us: Processing Items with the Mechanical Mixer
translations.zh_cn: 使用动力搅拌器处理物品

translations.en_us: With a Mixer and Basin, some Crafting Recipes can be automated
translations.zh_cn: 使用搅拌器和工作盆，你可以自动化某些合成配方

translations.en_us: Available recipes include any Shapeless Crafting Recipe, plus a couple extra ones
translations.zh_cn: 有效配方包括各种无序合成配方，以及一些额外的配方

translations.en_us: Some of those recipes may require the heat of a Blaze Burner
translations.zh_cn: 一些配方可能需要使用烈焰人燃烧室提供热量

translations.en_us: The filter slot can be used in case two recipes are conflicting.
translations.zh_cn: 过滤槽可用于解决两个配方相互冲突的情况。
使用动力活塞移动结构

translations.en_us: Mechanical Pistons can move blocks in front of them
translations.zh_cn: 动力活塞可以移动它前方的方块

translations.en_us: Speed and direction of movement depend on the Rotational Input
translations.zh_cn: 移动速度和方向取决于通入活塞的旋转力

translations.en_us: Sticky Mechanical Pistons can pull the attached blocks back
translations.zh_cn: 黏性动力活塞可以将连接的方块拉回来

translations.en_us: Movement Modes of the Mechanical Piston
Whenever Pistons stop moving, the moved structure reverts to blocks
translations.zh_cn: 一旦活塞停下，被移动的结构就会恢复到方块状态

translations.en_us: It can be configured never to revert to solid blocks, or only at the location it started at
translations.zh_cn: 你也可以将其配置为永不方块化，或者只在起始位置方块化
在动态结构中使用动力犁

translations.en_us: Whenever Ploughs are moved as part of an animated Contraption...
translations.zh_cn: 当动力犁作为动态结构的一部分移动时……

translations.en_us: ...they will break blocks without a solid collision hitbox
translations.zh_cn: ……它会破坏掉那些不具有固体碰撞箱的方块

translations.en_us: ...they can also launch entities without hurting them
translations.zh_cn: ……它也可以在不伤害实体的情况下推动它们

translations.en_us: Processing Items with the Mechanical Press
translations.zh_cn: 使用动力冲压机处理物品

translations.en_us: The Mechanical Press can process items provided beneath it
translations.zh_cn: 动力冲压机可以处理位于其下方的物品

translations.en_us: The Input items can be dropped or placed on a Depot under the Press
translations.zh_cn: 在其下方丢入物品，或者将物品放在置物台上，都算作有效的物品输入

translations.en_us: When items are provided on a belt...
The Press will hold and process them automatically
translations.zh_cn: 冲压机会使物品停下，然后自动处理这一物品

translations.en_us: Compacting items with the Mechanical Press
translations.zh_cn: 使用动力冲压机压缩物品

translations.en_us: Pressing items held in a Basin will cause them to be Compacted
translations.zh_cn: 对放置于工作盆内的物品进行冲压，可以将这些物品压缩在一起

translations.en_us: Compacting includes any filled 2x2 or 3x3 Crafting Recipe, plus a couple extra ones
translations.zh_cn: 压缩，指的是 2×2 或 3×3 同物品合成配方，以及一些额外的配方

translations.en_us: Some of those recipes may require the heat of a Blaze Burner
translations.zh_cn: 一些配方可能需要使用烈焰人燃烧室提供热量

translations.en_us: The filter slot can be used in case two recipes are conflicting.
translations.zh_cn: 过滤槽可用于解决两个配方相互冲突的情况。

translations.en_us: Mechanical Pumps govern the flow of their attached pipe networks
translations.zh_cn: 动力泵可以控制管道网络中的流体

translations.en_us: Their arrow indicates the direction of flow
translations.zh_cn: 其上的箭头指示流体流向

translations.en_us: The network behind is now pulling fluids...
translations.zh_cn: 泵后的管道网络正在抽取流体……

translations.en_us: ...while the network in front is transferring it outward
translations.zh_cn: ……而泵前的网络则在排放流体

translations.en_us: The pumps direction is unaffected by the input rotation
translations.zh_cn: 动力泵的方向不受旋转方向的影响

translations.en_us: Instead, a Wrench can be used to reverse the direction
translations.zh_cn: 取而代之的是，可以使用扳手来反转方向

translations.en_us: Regardless of speed, Mechanical Pumps affect pipes connected up to 16 blocks away
translations.zh_cn: 动力泵的压力最多沿管线传递 16 格，与输入动力无关

translations.en_us: Speeding up the input rotation changes the speed of flow propagation...
translations.zh_cn: 提高输入转速，可以加快流体的蔓延速度……

translations.en_us: ...and the speed at which fluids are transferred
Pumps can combine their throughputs within shared pipe networks
translations.zh_cn: 同一管道网络中的多个并联动力泵，它们的传输量可以叠加

translations.en_us: Ensure that all of them are facing in the same direction
translations.zh_cn: 确保它们都朝向同一方向
使用动力压路机填充地形

translations.en_us: While disassembled, rollers can be set to other modes
translations.zh_cn: 当方块化时，动力压路机可以被设为其他模式

translations.en_us: The 'fill' modes can help to bridge gaps between pavement and terrain
translations.zh_cn: “填充”模式可以帮你填充路面和地形之间的缝隙

translations.en_us: On 'straight fill', they will place simple columns down to the surface
translations.zh_cn: 在“竖直填充”模式，它们会简单地把方块以柱形放置到路面下方

translations.en_us: On 'sloped fill', layers placed further down will increase in size
translations.zh_cn: 在“坡度填充”模式，层数越靠下，填充面积就越大

translations.en_us: As opposed to 'clear & pave', neither of these modes will cause the rollers to break existing blocks
translations.zh_cn: 与“清理并铺路”相反，这些模式下，动力压路机不会破坏原有的方块

translations.en_us: Clearing and Paving with the Roller
translations.zh_cn: 使用动力压路机清理和铺路

translations.en_us: Mechanical rollers help to clean up terrain around tracks or paths
translations.zh_cn: 动力压路机可以帮助你清理轨道或道路周围的地形

translations.en_us: In its default mode, without a material set, it will simply clear blocks like a Drill
translations.zh_cn: 在默认模式，如果没有设定材料，它只会像钻头一样清理方块

translations.en_us: While disassembled, a suitable paving material can be specified
translations.zh_cn: 当方块化时，可以指定合适的铺路材料

translations.en_us: Materials can be supplied via chests or barrels attached to the structure
translations.zh_cn: 材料可通过附着在结构上的箱子或木桶供应

translations.en_us: In addition to breaking blocks, it will now replace the layer beneath them
translations.zh_cn: 除了破坏方块外，它现在将同时替换下面一层方块

translations.en_us: Note that any block destroyed by a roller has a chance not to yield drops
translations.zh_cn: 请注意，任何被压路机摧毁的方块都有可能不产生掉落物

translations.en_us: Rollers are especially useful on Trains, but can also be used on most other types of moving contraptions
translations.zh_cn: 动力压路机在列车上尤其好用，但也可以在大多数的动态结构上使用

translations.en_us: Cutting Trees with the Mechanical Saw
When given Rotational Force, a Mechanical Saw will cut trees directly in front of it
translations.zh_cn: 向其通入旋转力后，动力锯可以直接砍伐掉它面前的树木

translations.en_us: In order to cut the tree fully, the Saw has to break the last block connecting it to the ground
translations.zh_cn: 想要一次性砍掉整棵树，锯子必须破坏掉树与地面连接的最后一个方块
在动态结构中使用动力锯

translations.en_us: Whenever Saws are moved as part of an animated Contraption...
translations.zh_cn: 当动力锯作为动态结构的一部分移动时……

translations.en_us: ...they will cut any trees the contraption runs them into
translations.zh_cn: ……它会将撞到它的树木破坏掉

translations.en_us: Processing Items on the Mechanical Saw
Upward facing Mechanical Saws can process a variety of items
translations.zh_cn: 面朝上的动力锯可以处理各种物品

translations.en_us: The processed item always moves against the rotational input to the saw
translations.zh_cn: 处理过后的物品的弹出方向始终与通入锯中的旋转转向相反

translations.en_us: Saws can work in-line with Mechanical Belts
translations.zh_cn: 锯子可以与传送带放置在一条直线上，相互配合工作

translations.en_us: When an ingredient has multiple possible outcomes, the filter slot can specify it
translations.zh_cn: 若输入原料有多种可能产物，你可以用动力锯上的过滤槽指定只产出某种产物

translations.en_us: Without filter, the Saw would cycle through all outcomes instead
translations.zh_cn: 若没有使用过滤槽，动力锯会在各产物中按顺序循环输出

translations.en_us: Millstones process items by grinding them
translations.zh_cn: 石磨会对输入的物品进行研磨

translations.en_us: They can be powered from the side using cogwheels
translations.zh_cn: 在其侧边使用齿轮与其相耦合，方可为其通入动力

translations.en_us: Throw or Insert items at the top
translations.zh_cn: 顶部可以丢入或者塞入物品

translations.en_us: After some time, the result can be obtained via Right-click
translations.zh_cn: 一段时间过后，右击石磨可以拿出其中的产物

translations.en_us: The outputs can also be extracted by automation
translations.zh_cn: 产物的提取也是可以自动化的

translations.en_us: When powered by Redstone, Nixie Tubes will display the signal strength
translations.zh_cn: 当被红石充能时，辉光管会显示出信号的强度

translations.en_us: Using written Clipboards, custom text can be displayed
translations.zh_cn: 使用已书写的剪贴板，可以显示自定义文本

translations.en_us: Right-Click with Dye to change their display colour
translations.zh_cn: 使用染料右击，便可更改辉光管的显示颜色

translations.en_us: Right-click a Chain Conveyor and place the Frogport nearby
translations.zh_cn: 右击一条锁链并在其附近放置货物蛙港

translations.en_us: Packages find their path to a matching frog on the chain network
translations.zh_cn: 包裹会在锁链网络中寻找到达对应蛙港的路线

translations.en_us: Frogports can directly interface with inventories below them
translations.zh_cn: 货物蛙港可以直接访问其下方的容器

translations.en_us: This also works with packagers. Items can be packed and shipped directly
translations.zh_cn: 货物蛙港也可和打包机同时工作，物品在打包后会直接放到锁链物流线上

translations.en_us: Right-click Frogports with a clipboard to collect their address
translations.zh_cn: 用剪贴板右击蛙港来收集它们的地址

translations.en_us: Clipboards with collected names can help auto-complete address inputs in other UIs
translations.zh_cn: 记有地址的剪贴板可以用于在其他UI界面中自动完成地址输入

translations.en_us: Assign it an address in the inventory UI
translations.zh_cn: 在库存界面中为其分配一个地址

translations.en_us: If the address of an inserted package does not match it..
translations.zh_cn: 如果包裹记录的地址与蛙港不匹配……

translations.en_us: ..the Frogport will place the package on the conveyor
translations.zh_cn: 货物蛙港就会把包裹挂到锁链上

translations.en_us: Packages spin in place if they have no valid destination
translations.zh_cn: 如果没有有效的目的地，包裹就会在原地旋转

translations.en_us: More Frogports can be added anywhere on the chain network
translations.zh_cn: 可以在锁链网络中的任意位置添加更多的蛙港

translations.en_us: Attach packagers to the inventory they should target
translations.zh_cn: 将打包机对接到它们的目标库存

translations.en_us: Given redstone power, it will pack items from the inventory into a package
translations.zh_cn: 通入红石信号，它会把库存中的物品打包进包裹

translations.en_us: These can be picked up and transported like any other item
translations.zh_cn: 它们可以被捡起，也可以进行运输，就像其他任何物品一样

translations.en_us: Packages inserted will be destroyed, unpacking the contents into the inventory
translations.zh_cn: 放入打包机的包裹将被拆解，而内容物将存放到库存中

translations.en_us: Packagers will not accept packages they cannot fully unpack
translations.zh_cn: 打包机无法接收无法完全拆卸的包裹

translations.en_us: For compactness, mechanical saws can unpack straight onto a belt
translations.zh_cn: 动力锯可以拆解在传送带上的包裹从而保证结构的紧凑

translations.en_us: Aside from filters, Frogports and Postboxes have package routing abilities
translations.zh_cn: 除过滤器外，货物蛙港和邮箱亦可以指定包裹路线

translations.en_us: Inspect them to find out more about their behaviour
translations.zh_cn: 查看它们的思索界面来了解它们的行为

translations.en_us: When a sign is placed on a packager..
translations.zh_cn: 当一个告示牌被放置在打包机上时……

translations.en_us: Created packages will carry the written lines of text as their address
translations.zh_cn: 打包完毕的包裹将会携带一行写有其地址的文字

translations.en_us: Package filters route packages based on their address
translations.zh_cn: 包裹过滤器根据包裹的地址制定它们的路线

translations.en_us: Without attached Poles, a Mechanical Piston cannot move
translations.zh_cn: 若无相接的活塞杆，动力活塞将无法推动方块

translations.en_us: The Length of pole added at its back determines the Extension Range
translations.zh_cn: 在其背面安装的活塞杆长度，决定了活塞的推动范围

translations.en_us: Fluid Tanks on moving contraptions cannot be accessed by any pipes
translations.zh_cn: 管道无法与动态结构上的流体储罐直接交互

translations.en_us: This component can interact with fluid tanks without the need to stop the contraption
translations.zh_cn: 这一方块可以在不停止动态结构的情况下与动态结构上的流体储罐进行交互

translations.en_us: Place a second one with a gap of 1 or 2 blocks inbetween
translations.zh_cn: 放置第二个接口时，记得要与动态结构上的接口相隔 1 到 2 格的距离

translations.en_us: Whenever they pass by each other, they will engage in a connection
translations.zh_cn: 当它们经过彼此时，会连接到一起

translations.en_us: While engaged, the stationary interface will represent ALL Tanks on the contraption
translations.zh_cn: 接口连接状态下，固定端的接口便会作为整个动态结构流体储罐的代理
流体可被泵入到动态结构内……
……或是从动态结构中抽取出来

translations.en_us: After no contents have been exchanged for a while, the contraption will continue on its way
translations.zh_cn: 如果一小段时间内没有流体交换，接口将会断开连接，动态结构将会重新开始运动

translations.en_us: Moving inventories can be tricky to access with automation.
translations.zh_cn: 动态结构上的容器可能很难自动化存取。

translations.en_us: This component can interact with storage without the need to stop the contraption.
translations.zh_cn: 这一方块可以在不停止动态结构的情况下与动态结构上的容器进行交互。

translations.en_us: Place a second one with a gap of 1 or 2 blocks inbetween
translations.zh_cn: 放置第二个接口时，记得要与动态结构上的接口相隔 1 到 2 格的距离

translations.en_us: Whenever they pass by each other, they will engage in a connection
translations.zh_cn: 当它们经过彼此时，会连接到一起

translations.en_us: While engaged, the stationary interface will represent ALL inventories on the contraption
translations.zh_cn: 接口连接状态下，固定端的接口便会作为整个动态结构物品存储的代理
物品可被输入到动态结构内……
……或是从动态结构中提取出来

translations.en_us: After no items have been exchanged for a while, the contraption will continue on its way
translations.zh_cn: 如果一小段时间内没有物品交换，接口将会断开连接，动态结构将会重新开始运动

translations.en_us: Redstone power will prevent the stationary interface from engaging
translations.zh_cn: 通入红石信号可以阻止固定侧接口的连接行为

translations.en_us: Right-click a Train Station and place the Postbox nearby
translations.zh_cn: 右击列车站点并在其附近放置邮箱

translations.en_us: Just like trains, Postboxes maintain their behaviour in unloaded chunks
translations.zh_cn: 与列车类似，处在已卸载区块中的邮箱仍然会发挥作用

translations.en_us: Packages can still be delivered from or to their inventory
translations.zh_cn: 包裹仍然可以从它们的仓库中发出或接收

translations.en_us: Assign it an address in the inventory UI
translations.zh_cn: 在库存界面中为其分配一个地址

translations.en_us: If the address of an inserted package does not match it..
translations.zh_cn: 如果包裹记录的地址与邮箱不匹配……

translations.en_us: ..trains stopping at the station will collect it as cargo
translations.zh_cn: ……列车停靠在车站时会将其作为货物收集

translations.en_us: Conversely, packages matching the address will be dropped off
translations.zh_cn: 反之，地址相匹配的包裹将会被卸下

translations.en_us: Packages that arrived by train can be extracted from the Postbox
translations.zh_cn: 被列车运输到目的地的包裹可以从邮箱中取出

translations.en_us: Controlling signals using the Powered Latch
Powered Latches are redstone controllable Levers
translations.zh_cn: 锁存器是一种可以用红石信号控制的拉杆

translations.en_us: Signals at the back switch it on
translations.zh_cn: 后方输入的信号会将其设为开启状态

translations.en_us: Signals from the side switch it back off
translations.zh_cn: 侧边输入的信号会将其设为关闭状态

translations.en_us: Powered latches can also be toggled manually
translations.zh_cn: 你也可以手动切换其状态

translations.en_us: Controlling signals using the Powered Toggle Latch
translations.zh_cn: 使用转换锁存器控制信号

translations.en_us: Powered Toggle Latches are redstone controllable Levers
translations.zh_cn: 转换锁存器是一种可以用红石信号控制的拉杆

translations.en_us: Signals at the back will toggle its state
translations.zh_cn: 后方信号输入可以将其更改为

translations.en_us: Powered toggle latches can also be toggled manually
translations.zh_cn: 你也可以手动切换其状态
使用脉冲延长器控制信号

translations.en_us: Pulse Extenders can lengthen a signal passing through
translations.zh_cn: 脉冲延长器可以延长通过的信号

translations.en_us: They activate after a short delay...
translations.zh_cn: 它会在短暂延迟后激活……

translations.en_us: ...and cool down for the configured duration
translations.zh_cn: ……并在配置的持续时间后取消激活

translations.en_us: Using the value panel, the discharge time can be configured
translations.zh_cn: 通过面板，可以配置持续时间

translations.en_us: The configured duration can range up to an hour
translations.zh_cn: 配置的持续时间最长可达 1 小时
使用脉冲中继器控制信号

translations.en_us: Pulse Repeaters emit a short pulse after a delay
translations.zh_cn: 脉冲中继器会在延迟后发出一个短脉冲

translations.en_us: Using the value panel, the charge time can be configured
translations.zh_cn: 通过面板，可以配置充能时间

translations.en_us: Configured delays can range up to an hour
translations.zh_cn: 配置的延迟时间最长可达 1 小时

translations.en_us: Redstone output of the Pulse Timer
Pulse Timers repeatedly emit short pulses
translations.zh_cn: 脉冲计时器会周期性地发出脉冲信号

translations.en_us: Using the value panel, the time interval can be configured
translations.zh_cn: 打开其配置面板来调整其时间间隔

translations.en_us: Powering the input side will pause and reset them
translations.zh_cn: 对输入端进行充能会暂停并重置它们的工作

translations.en_us: Right-click the circuit base to invert the output
translations.zh_cn: 右击脉冲计时器以反转信号输出

translations.en_us: This helps trigger mechanisms that activate only without a redstone signal
translations.zh_cn: 这有助于触发仅在无红石信号情况下激活的机制
使用径向底盘黏着方块

translations.en_us: Radial Chassis connect to identical Chassis blocks in a row
translations.zh_cn: 相同的径向底盘会连接成一排

translations.en_us: When one is moved by a Contraption, the others are dragged with it
translations.zh_cn: 当其中的一个底盘被某个结构带动时，其余的底盘也会被带动

translations.en_us: The side faces of a Radial Chassis can be made Sticky
translations.zh_cn: 底盘的侧边可以变为黏性面

translations.en_us: Click again to make all other sides sticky
translations.zh_cn: 再次点击黏性面，可以让其所有面都变得带黏性

translations.en_us: Sneak and Right-Click with an empty hand to remove the slime
translations.zh_cn: 空手潜行右击可以移除其上的黏性物

translations.en_us: Whenever a Block is next to a sticky face...
translations.zh_cn: 若有物品与底盘的黏性面相接触……

translations.en_us: ...it will attach all reachable blocks within a radius on that layer
translations.zh_cn: ……底盘便会与同层且位于半径内的所有可到达方块黏着在一起

translations.en_us: Using a Wrench, a precise Radius can be specified for this chassis
translations.zh_cn: 使用扳手可以精确指定底盘的影响半径

translations.en_us: Blocks not reachable by any sticky face will not attach
translations.zh_cn: 任何黏性面都不可到达的方块不会被黏着
接触式红石信号发生器

translations.en_us: Redstone Contacts facing each other will emit a redstone signal
translations.zh_cn: 当两个接触式红石信号发生器面对面时，它们会发出红石信号

translations.en_us: This still applies when one of them is part of a moving Contraption
translations.zh_cn: 并且，若有一方位于动态结构上，此特性也能正常生效
使用无线红石信号终端

translations.en_us: Redstone Links can transmit redstone signals wirelessly
translations.zh_cn: 无线红石信号终端可以无线传输红石信号

translations.en_us: Right-click while Sneaking to toggle receive mode
translations.zh_cn: 潜行右击可以切换接收模式

translations.en_us: A simple Right-click with a Wrench can do the same
Receivers emit the redstone power of transmitters within 256 blocks
translations.zh_cn: 接收端会发出由发送端传来的红石强度，有效距离为 256 格

translations.en_us: Placing items in the two slots can specify a Frequency
translations.zh_cn: 在它们所带的槽位中放上物品，可以为它们指定频率

translations.en_us: Only the links with matching Frequencies will communicate
translations.zh_cn: 只有频率相互匹配的终端方可互通
使用红石请求器自动化订单

translations.en_us: Right-click a Stock link before placement to connect to its network
translations.zh_cn: 放置前，右击一个仓储链接站以连接至整个网络

translations.en_us: Just like Stock tickers, Redstone requesters can order items from the logistics network
translations.zh_cn: 与仓储发报机类似，红石请求器可以从物流网络中请求物品

translations.en_us: Right-click the requester to open its configuration UI
translations.zh_cn: 右击红石请求器来打开它的配置菜单

translations.en_us: The order set in the UI will be requested on every redstone pulse
translations.zh_cn: 每次红石脉冲都会请求界面中设置的订单

translations.en_us: Alternatively, the requester can be fully configured before placement
translations.zh_cn: 或者，红石请求器可以在放置之前进行完全配置

translations.en_us: Right-click a Stock keeper with it and set the desired order there
translations.zh_cn: 右击仓库管理员并设置所需要的订单

translations.en_us: Sometimes, it is crucial for logistical requests to arrive as a single package
translations.zh_cn: 有时，请求的货物有必要以单一的包裹送达

translations.en_us: Otherwise, other packages could arrive inbetween
translations.zh_cn: 否则，其他包裹可能混入其中

translations.en_us: When this is the case, redirect packages to an inventory
translations.zh_cn: 在这种情况下，将包裹重定向运输到一个存储方块中

translations.en_us: Attach a re-packager, and power it with redstone
translations.zh_cn: 在存储方块上放置一个理包机，并用红石信号激活

translations.en_us: Once all fragments arrived, they will be exported as a new package
translations.zh_cn: 一旦所有分包裹送达，它们将会被打包成一个新包裹并输出

translations.en_us: Now, requested items arrive together and in a predictable order
translations.zh_cn: 如此，请求的物品将被以可预测的顺序一同送达
使用绳索滑轮移动结构

translations.en_us: Rope Pulleys can move blocks vertically when given Rotational Force
translations.zh_cn: 绳索滑轮在接受旋转力时可以垂直移动方块结构

translations.en_us: Direction and Speed of movement depend on the Rotational Input
translations.zh_cn: 移动的方向及速度取决于提供的转速

translations.en_us: Moving Pulleys as part of a Contraption
translations.zh_cn: 绳索滑轮与结构一同运动

translations.en_us: Whenever Pulleys are themselves being moved by a Contraption...
translations.zh_cn: 当绳索滑轮本身在结构中被带动时……

translations.en_us: ...its attached structure will be dragged with it
translations.zh_cn: ……附着在滑轮上的结构会被滑轮拉着一同移动

translations.en_us: Mind that pulleys are only movable while stopped
translations.zh_cn: 注意，只有绳索滑轮停止工作时才能被移动

translations.en_us: Movement Modes of the Rope Pulley
Whenever Pulleys stop moving, the moved structure reverts to blocks
translations.zh_cn: 当绳索滑轮停止运动时，它所附着的动态结构便会方块化

translations.en_us: It can be configured never to revert to solid blocks, or only at the location it started at
translations.zh_cn: 你可以调整使整个结构永不方块化，或者仅在结构的初始位置方块化

translations.en_us: Whenever a pulley assembles a contraption...
translations.zh_cn: 当使用一个滑轮组装了一个动态结构……

translations.en_us: ...other pulleys on the same layer will connect to the structure
translations.zh_cn: ……同一高度的其他滑轮也会被连接到结构上

translations.en_us: They do not require to be powered, the effect is purely cosmetic
translations.zh_cn: 它们不需要接入动力，且只有装饰效果

translations.en_us: Rose Quartz Lamps activate on a Redstone signal
translations.zh_cn: 玫瑰石英灯通入红石信号后会处于激活状态

translations.en_us: They will continue to emit redstone power afterwards
translations.zh_cn: 它们之后会继续产生红石信号

translations.en_us: When multiple lamps are arranged in a group...
...activating a Lamp will focus the signal to it, deactivating all others
translations.zh_cn: ……激活一盏灯会集中信号给它，并熄灭其余的灯

translations.en_us: Comparators output based on the distance to a powered lamp
translations.zh_cn: 比较器根据到激活的灯的距离产生输出

translations.en_us: The Lamps can also be toggled manually using a Wrench
translations.zh_cn: 灯也可以用扳手手动开关

translations.en_us: Rot. Speed Controllers relay rotation from their axis to a Large Cogwheel above them
translations.zh_cn: 转速控制器将旋转力从其转轴传递至它上方的大齿轮

translations.en_us: Using the value panel on its side, the conveyed speed can be configured
translations.zh_cn: 通过其侧边的面板，可以调节输出转速
使用风车风帆来组装风车

translations.en_us: Sails are handy blocks to create Windmills with
translations.zh_cn: 风车风帆是组装风车的趁手材料

translations.en_us: They will attach to blocks and each other without the need of Super Glue or Chassis Blocks
translations.zh_cn: 无需强力胶等黏合手段，它们也可以自行相互连接

translations.en_us: Right-Click with Dye to paint them
translations.zh_cn: 手持染料右击可对其染色

translations.en_us: Right-Click with Shears to turn them back into frames
translations.zh_cn: 手持剪刀右击可剪除帆布，使其变为风帆框架
使用风帆框架来组装风车

translations.en_us: Sail Frames are handy blocks to create Windmills with
translations.zh_cn: 风帆框架是组装风车的趁手材料

translations.en_us: They will attach to blocks and each other without the need of Super Glue or Chassis Blocks
translations.zh_cn: 无需强力胶等黏合手段，它们也可以自行相互连接

translations.en_us: Controlling Rotational Speed using Sequenced Gearshifts
translations.zh_cn: 使用可编程齿轮箱来控制转速

translations.en_us: Seq. Gearshifts relay rotation by following a timed list of instructions
translations.zh_cn: 可编程齿轮箱能够根据玩家设置的预设时序表来传递旋转

translations.en_us: Right-click it to open the Configuration UI
translations.zh_cn: 对其右击可以打开设置面板

translations.en_us: Upon receiving a Redstone Signal, it will start running its configured sequence
translations.zh_cn: 接受红石信号时，它会开始执行其内部已配置好的时序指令表

translations.en_us: Once finished, it waits for the next Redstone Signal and starts over
translations.zh_cn: 当完成时序指令表后，它会进入待机状态，再次接受红石信号后，它才会再次执行时序指令表内容

translations.en_us: A redstone comparator can be used to read the current progress
translations.zh_cn: 红石比较器可以读取当前时序指令表完成进度
使用传动杆传递旋转力

translations.en_us: Shafts will relay rotation in a straight line.
translations.zh_cn: 传动杆能直线传递旋转力

translations.en_us: Brass or Andesite Casing can be used to decorate Shafts
translations.zh_cn: 安山机壳或黄铜机壳，可以用来装饰传动杆

translations.en_us: This behaviour can be modified using the value panel
translations.zh_cn: 可以通过面板调整它的行为

translations.en_us: With the help of Super Glue, larger structures can be moved.
translations.zh_cn: 有了强力胶，移动起大型结构轻轻松松。

translations.en_us: Inventories attached to the Contraption will pick up their drops automatically
translations.zh_cn: 与该结构相接的容器，会自动拾取结构遇到的掉落物
使用智能溜槽过滤物品

translations.en_us: Smart Chutes are vertical chutes with additional control
translations.zh_cn: 智能溜槽是垂直溜槽的升级控制版

translations.en_us: Items in the filter slot specify what to extract or transfer
translations.zh_cn: 过滤槽可以使溜槽仅传输指定的物品

translations.en_us: Use the value panel to specify the extracted stack size
translations.zh_cn: 使用面板可以指定被过滤的物品数量

translations.en_us: Redstone power will prevent Smart Chutes from acting.
translations.zh_cn: 通入红石信号可以使智能溜槽停止工作
使用智能侦测器进行高级检测

translations.en_us: Smart Observers can be used to detect a variety of events
translations.zh_cn: 智能侦测器可以用于检测各种事件

translations.en_us: It can detect items or fluids inside of generic containers
translations.zh_cn: 它可以检测一般容器内的物品或液体

translations.en_us: The filter slot can be used to look for specific contents only
translations.zh_cn: 过滤插槽可以用于检测特定内容物

translations.en_us: It also activates when the block itself matches the filter
translations.zh_cn: 当方块本身与过滤器匹配时，它也会激活

translations.en_us: Additionally, smart observers can monitor belts, chutes and pipes
translations.zh_cn: 此外，智能侦测器可以监测传送带、溜槽和管道

translations.en_us: ...and will emit a pulse, if an item enters or exits a funnel
translations.zh_cn: ……并在物品进入或离开漏斗时输出红石脉冲

translations.en_us: Controlling Fluid flow using Smart Pipes
translations.zh_cn: 使用智能流体管道控制流体流动

translations.en_us: Smart pipes can help control flows by fluid type
translations.zh_cn: 智能流体管道可以限制通过它的流体种类

translations.en_us: When placed directly at the source, they can specify the type of fluid to extract
translations.zh_cn: 当紧邻流体源放置时，管道只会抽取设置的流体种类

translations.en_us: Simply Right-Click their filter slot with any item containing the desired fluid
translations.zh_cn: 使用任何包含流体的容器右击过滤槽，可以标记过滤的流体

translations.en_us: When placed further down a pipe network, smart pipes will only let matching fluids continue
translations.zh_cn: 当放在管道网络中时，只有匹配过滤器的流体才能通过此管道

translations.en_us: Monitoring Kinetic information using the Speedometer
translations.zh_cn: 使用转速表来监测转速

translations.en_us: The Speedometer displays the current Speed of attached components
translations.zh_cn: 转速表能显示相接元件的转速

translations.en_us: When wearing Engineers' Goggles, the player can get more detailed information from the Gauge
translations.zh_cn: 当佩戴工程师护目镜时，可以看到仪表所显示的更详细的数据

translations.en_us: Comparators can emit analog Redstone Signals relative to the Speedometer's measurements
translations.zh_cn: 红石比较器可以根据转速表的数值输出不同强度的红石信号

translations.en_us: The Spout can fill fluid holding items provided beneath it
translations.zh_cn: 注液器可以将流体装入下方经过且可以接受该流体的物品

translations.en_us: The content of a Spout cannot be accessed manually
translations.zh_cn: 注液器的流体容器无法直接手动交互

translations.en_us: Instead, Pipes can be used to supply it with fluids
translations.zh_cn: 使用管道可以将流体输入到注液器内

translations.en_us: The Input items can be placed on a Depot under the Spout
translations.zh_cn: 输入的物品可以被放置在其下方的置物台上

translations.en_us: When items are provided on a belt...
translations.zh_cn: 当传送带上的物品经过注液器下方时……

translations.en_us: The Spout will hold and process them automatically
translations.zh_cn: 注液器会使物品停下，然后自动处理这一物品

translations.en_us: Whenever Mechanical Bearings are themselves part of a moving Structure..
translations.zh_cn: 当动力轴承在结构被带动时……

translations.en_us: ..they will attempt to keep themselves upright
translations.zh_cn: ……它会确保它转盘的垂直朝向不变

translations.en_us: Once again, the bearing will attach to the block in front of it
translations.zh_cn: 同样的，这个动力轴承也会黏着其正面上的方块

translations.en_us: As a result, the entire sub-Contraption will stay upright
translations.zh_cn: 这种情况下，它所黏着的子结构的垂直朝向也不会改变

translations.en_us: Steam Engines can be placed on a Fluid Tank
translations.zh_cn: 蒸汽引擎可以放置在流体储罐上

translations.en_us: Clicking the engine with a Shaft creates the Kinetic Output
translations.zh_cn: 手持传动杆点击引擎创建动力输出

translations.en_us: With sufficient Heat, Water and Boiler space...
translations.zh_cn: 有充足的热量、水和锅炉空间……

translations.en_us: The minimal setup requires 4 Fluid Tanks
translations.zh_cn: 最低配置需要4个流体储罐

translations.en_us: With the help of Blaze Burners, the power output can be increased
translations.zh_cn: 在烈焰人燃烧室的帮助下，可以增加输出功率

translations.en_us: Higher power levels require more Water, Size and Heat
translations.zh_cn: 更高的功率等级需要更多水、空间和热量

translations.en_us: The boiler's current power level can be inspected with Engineer's Goggles
translations.zh_cn: 可以用工程师护目镜检查当前锅炉的功率等级

translations.en_us: With each added power level, an additional Engine can output at full capacity
translations.zh_cn: 每提升一个功率等级，就可以多装一个满功率输出的蒸汽引擎

translations.en_us: Steam Whistles can be placed on a Fluid Tank
translations.zh_cn: 蒸汽笛能够被放置在流体储罐上

translations.en_us: If the tank receives sufficient heat...
translations.zh_cn: 若流体储罐达到足够的温度……

translations.en_us: ...the Whistle will play a note when activated
translations.zh_cn: ……此时，用红石信号激活蒸汽笛，它便会演奏单个音符

translations.en_us: Use a Whistle item on the block to lower its pitch
translations.zh_cn: 在蒸汽笛上叠加蒸汽笛来降低它的音高

translations.en_us: Cycle between three different octaves using a Wrench
translations.zh_cn: 使用扳手来在三个八度之间切换

translations.en_us: Engineer's Goggles can help to find out the current pitch of a Whistle
translations.zh_cn: 工程师护目镜能够帮你查看蒸汽笛的音高
使用黏着器来黏吸方块

translations.en_us: Stickers are ideal for Redstone-controlled block attachment
translations.zh_cn: 你可以用红石信号来控制黏着器的行为

translations.en_us: Upon receiving a signal, it will toggle its state
translations.zh_cn: 当接受红石信号时，黏着器会黏着前方的方块

translations.en_us: If it is now moved in a contraption, the block will move with it
translations.zh_cn: 如果黏着器以结构的形式移动，其黏着的方块也会一同移动

translations.en_us: Toggled once again, the block is no longer attached
translations.zh_cn: 再次接受红石信号时，它会断开与方块的黏连

translations.en_us: Logistics Networks and the Stock Link
translations.zh_cn: 物流网络和仓储链接站

translations.en_us: When placed, Stock Links create a new stock network
translations.zh_cn: 仓储链接站会在它被放置的时候创建一个新的库存网络

translations.en_us: Right-click an existing link before placing it to bind them
translations.zh_cn: 放置前，右击一个已存在的仓储链接站来绑定它们

translations.en_us: Stock-linked packagers make their inventory available to the network
translations.zh_cn: 仓储链接站所链接的打包机，会把连接的库存接入网络

translations.en_us: Other components on the network can now find and request their items
translations.zh_cn: 网络上的其他元件可以寻找并请求其中的物品

translations.en_us: On request, items from the inventories will be placed into packages
translations.zh_cn: 根据请求，将库存中的物品放入包裹

translations.en_us: Stock Link signals have unlimited range, but packages require transportation
translations.zh_cn: 仓储链接站的信号范围是无限的，但是包裹需要运输

translations.en_us: Full redstone power will stop a link from broadcasting
translations.zh_cn: 满格的红石信号将阻止链接站的信号传输

translations.en_us: Analog power lowers the priority of a link, causing others to act first
translations.zh_cn: 红石信号越强，该链接器的信号优先级越低，相对提高其他链接器的优先级
用仓储发报机请求物品

translations.en_us: Right-click a Stock link before placement to connect to its network
translations.zh_cn: 放置前，右击一个仓储链接站以连接至整个网络

translations.en_us: Stock tickers can also order blocks required for the schematicannon
translations.zh_cn: 仓储发报机也可以下单蓝图加农炮需要的方块

translations.en_us: Simply hand the printed clipboard it generated to the Stock keeper
translations.zh_cn: 仅需将生成的剪贴板交给仓库管理员

translations.en_us: Stock-linked packagers make their attached inventory available to the network
translations.zh_cn: 仓储链接站所链接的打包机，会把连接的库存接入网络

translations.en_us: Stock tickers can order items from these inventories
translations.zh_cn: 仓储发报机可以从它们的库存中请求物品

translations.en_us: Seated mobs or blaze burners in front of it act as the Stock Keeper
translations.zh_cn: 坐下的生物或者烈焰人燃烧室都可以作为仓库管理员

translations.en_us: Right-click the keeper to start ordering items
When an order is submitted, the items will be placed into packages
translations.zh_cn: 提交一个订单之后，可用物品就会被打包进包裹中

translations.en_us: From there, they can be transported to the request point
translations.zh_cn: 然后，它们可以传输到请求的目标位置

translations.en_us: Using attribute or list filters, categories can be added to the item listings
translations.zh_cn: 使用属性或列表过滤器来为列表提供物品过滤

translations.en_us: Right-click the Stock ticker to open the category editor
translations.zh_cn: 右击仓储发报机来打开类别编辑器
定位一个仓储发报机订单

translations.en_us: When ordering items, a target address can be set in the request
translations.zh_cn: 当下单物品时，可以在请求中设置目标地址

translations.en_us: Aside from filters, Frogports and Postboxes have package routing abilities
translations.zh_cn: 除过滤器外，货物蛙港和邮箱亦可以指定包裹路线

translations.en_us: Inspect them to find out more about their behaviour
translations.zh_cn: 查看它们的思索界面来了解它们的行为

translations.en_us: This address will be on all packages created for the request
translations.zh_cn: 所有请求的包裹都会发到这个地址

translations.en_us: Using package filters, this can control where the packages will go
translations.zh_cn: 亦可以通过包裹过滤器控制其去向

translations.en_us: Monitoring Kinetic information using the Stressometer
translations.zh_cn: 使用应力表来监测应力

translations.en_us: The Stressometer displays the current Stress Capacity of the attached kinetic network
translations.zh_cn: 应力表能显示当前动力网络内的应力信息

translations.en_us: When wearing Engineers' Goggles, the player can get more detailed information from the Gauge
translations.zh_cn: 当佩戴工程师护目镜时，可以看到仪表所显示的更详细的数据

translations.en_us: Comparators can emit analog Redstone Signals relative to the Stressometer's measurements
translations.zh_cn: 红石比较器可以根据应力表的数值输出不同强度的红石信号
使用强力胶来黏合方块

translations.en_us: Super Glue groups blocks together into moving contraptions
translations.zh_cn: 强力胶用于将方块组合成动态结构

translations.en_us: Clicking two endpoints creates a new 'glued' area
translations.zh_cn: 右击两个端点来创建一个新的“胶合”区域

translations.en_us: To remove a box, punch it with the glue item in hand
translations.zh_cn: 手持强力胶左击可以移除选区

translations.en_us: Adjacent blocks sharing an area will pull each other along
translations.zh_cn: 同一个选区内相邻的方块会互相拉动对方

translations.en_us: Overlapping glue volumes will move together
translations.zh_cn: 互相重叠的选区会一起移动

translations.en_us: Blocks hanging on others usually do not require glue
translations.zh_cn: 悬挂在其它方块上的方块通常不需要强力胶

translations.en_us: Table cloths can be used to display items
translations.zh_cn: 桌布可以用来展示物品

translations.en_us: When checking out at the cashier, the bought items will be placed into a package
translations.zh_cn: 结账时，购买的物品将会被打包进一个包裹中

translations.en_us: From there, they can be transported to the shop front
translations.zh_cn: 然后，它们可以传输到商铺店面

translations.en_us: The payments will be stored inside the stock ticker block
translations.zh_cn: 交付的物品将会被存储在仓储发报机内

translations.en_us: With the help of a logistics system, they can also be used to sell items
translations.zh_cn: 在物流系统的帮助下，它们亦可用于出售物品

translations.en_us: Start with the shop's inventory, a Packager and Stock link
translations.zh_cn: 从商店的库存、打包机和仓储链接站开始

translations.en_us: Bind a Stock ticker to the link and place it in the shop
translations.zh_cn: 将一个仓储发报机绑定至仓储链接站并且置于商店内

translations.en_us: Employ a mob or blaze burner as the shop keeper
